WITH "top_user" AS (SELECT id FROM "users" ORDER BY reputation DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".score > 50) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "top_user" AS "u" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id LIMIT 501

WITH "prolific" AS (SELECT "p".owneruserid AS "userid" FROM "posts" AS "p" WHERE "p"."creaiondate" >= '2012-01-01' AND "p"."creaiondate" < '2013-01-01' AND "p".owneruserid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".owneruserid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10), "upvotes" AS (SELECT "v".userid, COUNT(*) AS "upvote_count" FROM "votes" AS "v" WHERE "v".votetypeid = 2 GROUP BY "v".userid) SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("u".upvote_count, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_upvotes_cast", ROUND(AVG("us".age)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_age" FROM "prolific" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "us" ON "us".id = "p".userid LEFT JOIN "upvotes" AS "u" ON "u".userid = "p".userid LIMIT 501

WITH "totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, "c".customerid, SUM("y".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date >= '2013-01' AND "y".date < '2014-01' GROUP BY "c".segment, "c".customerid), "ranked" AS (SELECT segment, customerid, total_consumption, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_consumption ASC, customerid ASC) AS "rn" FROM "totals"), "chosen" AS (SELECT segment, total_consumption FROM "ranked" WHERE rn = 1) SELECT ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "sme_minus_lam", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "lam_minus_kam", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "kam_minus_sme" FROM "chosen" LIMIT 501

WITH "totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date >= '2012-01' AND "y".date < '2013-01') AS "consumption_2012", SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date >= '2013-01' AND "y".date < '2014-01') AS "consumption_2013" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date >= '2012-01' AND "y".date < '2014-01' GROUP BY "c".segment), "increases" AS (SELECT segment, ROUND(((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / NULLIF(consumption_2012, 0) * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "totals"), "extremes" AS (SELECT MIN(increase_percentage) AS "lowest", MAX(increase_percentage) AS "highest" FROM "increases") SELECT "i".segment, "i".increase_percentage FROM "increases" AS "i" CROSS JOIN "extremes" AS "e" WHERE "i".increase_percentage = "e".lowest OR "i".increase_percentage = "e".highest ORDER BY "i".increase_percentage ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "annual_totals" AS (SELECT SUM(consumption) FILTER (WHERE LEFT(date, 4) = '2012') AS "total_2012", SUM(consumption) FILTER (WHERE LEFT(date, 4) = '2013') AS "total_2013" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE customerid = 6718) SELECT ROUND(((total_2013 - total_2012) / total_2012)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "relative_change" FROM "annual_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "y2012".customerid) FROM "yearmonth" AS "y2012" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y2013" ON "y2012".customerid = "y2013".customerid INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y2012".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "y2012".date >= '2012-01-01' AND "y2012".date < '2013-01-01' AND "y2013".date >= '2013-01-01' AND "y2013".date < '2014-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "annual_consumption" AS (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE "date" >= '201201' AND "date" < '201301' GROUP BY customerid), "active_2012" AS (SELECT DISTINCT customerid FROM "transactions_1k" WHERE "date" >= DATE '2012-01-01' AND "date" < DATE '2013-01-01') SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "annual_consumption" AS "a" ON "a".customerid = "c".customerid INNER JOIN "active_2012" AS "t" ON "t".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "a".total_consumption < 30000 GROUP BY "c".segment ORDER BY "c".segment ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(DISTINCT "y".customerid) AS "customers_who_consumed_fuel" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "y".date >= '2013-01-01' AND "y".date < '2014-01-01' AND "y".consumption > 0 GROUP BY "c".segment LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".currency, ROUND(AVG("q".quarter_consumption)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_quarter_consumption" FROM (SELECT "ym".customerid, SUM("ym".consumption) AS "quarter_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" AS "ym" WHERE "ym".date >= '2013-04-01' AND "ym".date < '2013-07-01' GROUP BY "ym".customerid) AS "q" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "q".customerid GROUP BY "c".currency ORDER BY "c".currency ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(MAX(monthly_total) FILTER (WHERE year = 2013) - MAX(monthly_total) FILTER (WHERE year = 2012)) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("date", 'YYYYMM')) AS "year", SUM(consumption) AS "monthly_total" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE TO_DATE("date", 'YYYYMM') >= DATE '2012-01-01' AND TO_DATE("date", 'YYYYMM') < DATE '2014-01-01' GROUP BY TO_DATE("date", 'YYYYMM')) AS "monthly_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "c".currency = 'CZK' THEN "y".consumption END) - AVG(CASE WHEN "c".currency = 'EUR' THEN "y".consumption END)) AS "difference" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "y".date >= '2012-01' AND "y".date < '2013-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM (SELECT "c".customerid FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'KAM' AND "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "y".date >= '2013-01-01' AND "y".date < '2014-01-01' GROUP BY "c".customerid HAVING SUM("y".consumption) > 1000000) AS "qualifying_customers" LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "branch_district".district_id, "branch_district".a11 FROM "district" AS "branch_district" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "branch_district".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "branch_district".a3 = 'east Bohemia' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') SELECT ROUND(AVG(a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_of_districts_average_salaries", COUNT(*) AS "district_count" FROM "qualifying_districts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "region" ON "region".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "account_disp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "account_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "account_disp".disp_id) AS "accounts_with_cards" ON "accounts_with_cards".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id WHERE "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' AND "region".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "accounts_with_cards".account_id IS NULL) AS "qualifying_districts" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "qualifying_districts".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0)), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "d".account_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND "t".k_symbol <> ' ' AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976 AND "t".amount > 4000 LIMIT 501

WITH "borrowing" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, SUM("l".amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".account_id), "counterparties" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "t".account) AS "outside_counterparty_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".account_id), "household" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "account_opening_date", "b".total_amount_borrowed, COALESCE("cp".outside_counterparty_count, 0) AS "outside_counterparty_count", "home".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "home".a8 AS "home_district_population" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "borrowing" AS "b" ON "b".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN "counterparties" AS "cp" ON "cp".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice') SELECT account_id, account_opening_date, total_amount_borrowed, outside_counterparty_count, owner_home_district, home_district_population, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY home_district_population DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "household" ORDER BY home_district_population DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_avg" AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS "avg_balance" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "eligible_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a10 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id INNER JOIN "account_avg" AS "aa" ON "aa".account_id = "a".account_id AND "aa".avg_balance > 1000 INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND "d".a4::BIGINT > 100000), "district_stats" AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", MAX(inhabitants) AS "max_inhabitants", ROUND(AVG(salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_salary", ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_urban_ratio" FROM "eligible_districts" GROUP BY gender) SELECT CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' WHEN 'M' THEN 'men' END AS "gender", "s".district_count, "e".district_id, "e".inhabitants, "s".avg_salary, "s".avg_urban_ratio FROM "district_stats" AS "s" INNER JOIN "eligible_districts" AS "e" ON "e".gender = "s".gender AND "e".inhabitants = "s".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, "e".district_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol <> ' ' LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "dp".client_id, "dp".account_id, "c".district_id FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "dp".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "dp".type = 'OWNER'), "districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a8 AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "average_salary", "d".a13 AS "unemployment_1996" FROM "qualifying_accounts" AS "q" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "q".district_id) SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(average_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG(unemployment_1996)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_unemployment_rate", (ARRAY_AGG(district_name ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC))[1] AS "most_populous_district" FROM "districts" GROUP BY region LIMIT 501

WITH "top_counts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a8 AS "inhabitants", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "crimes" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a8 ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 3) SELECT district_name, crimes, ROUND(AVG(crimes::NUMERIC) OVER (), 2) AS "three_district_average" FROM "top_counts" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "card_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ca"."type" AS "card_type", "cl".district_id, "di".a2 AS "home_district", "di".a8 AS "inhabitants" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "di" ON "di".district_id = "cl".district_id) SELECT card_type, home_district, inhabitants FROM "card_districts" AS "cd" WHERE inhabitants = (SELECT MIN(inhabitants) FROM "card_districts" WHERE card_type = "cd".card_type) ORDER BY CASE card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, home_district ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "litomerice_region" AS (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'), "opened_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "litomerice_region" AS "r" ON "r".a3 = "d".a3 WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "ranked_transactions" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, "t".balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t".account_id ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "opened_accounts" AS "oa" ON "oa".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "account_balances" AS (SELECT "oa".account_id, "oa".district_id, "oa".district_name, "rt".balance FROM "opened_accounts" AS "oa" LEFT JOIN "ranked_transactions" AS "rt" ON "rt".account_id = "oa".account_id AND "rt".rn = 1), "district_summary" AS (SELECT district_id, district_name, COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened_1996", ROUND(AVG(balance)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_end_1996_balance" FROM "account_balances" GROUP BY district_id, district_name), "region_summary" AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "region_wide_average_end_1996_balance" FROM "account_balances"), "highest_district" AS (SELECT district_name AS "district_with_highest_average_end_1996_balance" FROM "account_balances" GROUP BY district_id, district_name ORDER BY AVG(balance) DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "ds".district_name, "ds".accounts_opened_1996, "ds".average_end_1996_balance, "rs".region_wide_average_end_1996_balance, "hd".district_with_highest_average_end_1996_balance FROM "district_summary" AS "ds" CROSS JOIN "region_summary" AS "rs" CROSS JOIN "highest_district" AS "hd" ORDER BY "ds".district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "top_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".amount, "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10), "districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a4 AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "average_salary" FROM "top_loans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "t".district_id) SELECT (SELECT inhabitants FROM "districts" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "inhabitants", ROUND(AVG(average_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary_across_districts" FROM "districts" LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id, "a".date, "a".frequency, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "d".district_id = "c".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "home_district", "d".a12 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id) AS "transaction_count", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("t".amount), 0) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_income", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("t".amount), 0) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ') AS "total_expense", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("t".amount), 0) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".type = 'PRIJEM') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("t".amount), 0) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ') AS "net_balance", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "client" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "district" AS "hd" ON "hd".district_id = "c2".district_id WHERE "hd".a3 = "d".a3) AS "regional_client_count", (SELECT "d2".a2 FROM "district" AS "d2" WHERE "d2".a3 = "d".a3 ORDER BY "d2".a8 DESC LIMIT 1) AS "most_populous_district", (SELECT "d2".a8 FROM "district" AS "d2" WHERE "d2".a3 = "d".a3 ORDER BY "d2".a8 DESC LIMIT 1) AS "most_populous_district_inhabitants", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "district" AS "d2" WHERE "d2".a3 = "d".a3 AND "d2".a8 > "d".a8) + 1 AS "population_rank" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "c".client_id = 3541 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_lending" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::INTEGER AS "opening_year", "al".district_id, SUM("al".amount_lent) AS "amount_lent", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened" FROM "account_lending" AS "al" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::INTEGER, "al".district_id) SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::INTEGER::TEXT AS "opening_year", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM("al".amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG("dy".amount_lent::NUMERIC / "dy".accounts_opened), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "account_lending" AS "al" INNER JOIN "district_year" AS "dy" ON "dy".district_id = "al".district_id WHERE "dy".opening_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::INTEGER GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::INTEGER ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::INTEGER ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".date AS "approval_date", "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "ranked" AS (SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "e".amount DESC, "e".approval_date ASC, "e".loan_id ASC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "eligible" AS "e"), "latest_daily_balance" AS (SELECT "r".loan_id, "t".balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "r".loan_id ORDER BY "t".trans_id DESC) AS "txn_rank" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "r".account_id AND "t".date = "r".approval_date) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "r".amount AS "approved_amount", "r".approval_date, "b".balance AS "end_of_day_account_balance" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "r".district_id LEFT JOIN "latest_daily_balance" AS "b" ON "b".loan_id = "r".loan_id AND "b".txn_rank = 1 WHERE "r".loan_rank <= 10 ORDER BY "r".amount DESC, "r".approval_date ASC, "r".loan_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "client_cards" AS (SELECT "cl".client_id, "cl".gender, "cl".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", "ca".issued, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "cl".birth_date)::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary", "dp".account_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01'), "account_loans" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id), "profiled" AS (SELECT "cc".client_id, "cc".gender, "cc".birth_date, "cc".card_type, "cc".age_at_issue, COALESCE("al".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("al".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("al".number_of_loans, 0) > 0 AND "cc".age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN COALESCE("al".number_of_loans, 0) > 0 AND "cc".age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "cc".district_name, "cc".district_average_salary, "cc".account_id FROM "client_cards" AS "cc" LEFT JOIN "account_loans" AS "al" ON "al".account_id = "cc".account_id) SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, card_type, age_at_issue, number_of_loans, total_amount_borrowed, borrower_classification, district_name, district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "profiled" ORDER BY client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol = ' ' GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = (SELECT "l".account_id FROM "loan" AS "l" WHERE "l".loan_id = 98832) AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".account_id) FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" WHERE "d".client_id = 2823) AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".client_id, "l".amount AS "loan_amount", "l".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND(("l".payments * "l".duration)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND(("l".payments * "l".duration - "l".amount)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "interest_paid", "l".status AS "loan_status", "branch".a2 AS "district", "branch".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("tx".total_deposits, 0) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("tx".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "l".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("tx".total_deposits, 0) > "l".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "loan" AS "all_loans" INNER JOIN "account" AS "la" ON "la".account_id = "all_loans".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "ld" ON "ld".district_id = "la".district_id WHERE "ld".a3 = "branch".a3) AS "region_loan_count", (SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a12)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = "branch".a3) AS "avg_district_salary", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "c".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "age" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "l".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "tx" ON "tx".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "l".amount >= (SELECT MIN("top_amount".amount) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "l2".amount FROM "loan" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d2" ON "d2".account_id = "l2".account_id AND "d2".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c2" ON "c2".client_id = "d2".client_id WHERE "c2".gender = 'F' ORDER BY "l2".amount DESC LIMIT 3) AS "top_amount") ORDER BY "l".amount DESC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration > 24 AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(DISTINCT "qa".account_id) AS "qualifying_account_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" ON "qa".district_id = "d".district_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a3), "region_totals" AS (SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS "qualifying_district_count", SUM(qualifying_account_count) AS "qualifying_account_count" FROM "qualifying_districts" GROUP BY region), "region_populations" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", SUM("d".a8::BIGINT) AS "combined_population" FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM "qualifying_districts") GROUP BY "d".a3) SELECT "rt".region, "rt".qualifying_district_count, "rp".combined_population, "rt".qualifying_account_count FROM "region_totals" AS "rt" INNER JOIN "region_populations" AS "rp" ON "rp".region = "rt".region ORDER BY "rp".combined_population DESC, "rt".region ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM("monthly_accounts".account_count) AS "total_monthly_accounts", COUNT(*) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("monthly_accounts".avg_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT "d".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count", "d".a11 AS "avg_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a11) AS "monthly_accounts" LIMIT 501

WITH "gold_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".disp_id = "c".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold'), "transaction_totals" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_amount_received", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ') AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FILTER (WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "gold_accounts" AS "g" ON "g".account_id = "t".account_id GROUP BY "t".account_id), "loan_counts" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "gold_accounts" AS "g" ON "g".account_id = "l".account_id GROUP BY "l".account_id) SELECT "g".account_id AS "account_id", "district".a2 AS "district_name", "district".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_received, 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COALESCE("lc".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("tt".external_counterparties, 0) AS "external_counterparties", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("tt".external_counterparties, 0) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "gold_accounts" AS "g" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "g".account_id INNER JOIN "district" ON "district".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_totals" AS "tt" ON "tt".account_id = "g".account_id LEFT JOIN "loan_counts" AS "lc" ON "lc".account_id = "g".account_id ORDER BY rank ASC, "g".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Tabor' AND "a".date <= DATE '1996-12-31'), "owner_info" AS (SELECT "disp".account_id, "client".gender, "client".birth_date FROM "disp" INNER JOIN "client" ON "client".client_id = "disp".client_id WHERE "disp".type = 'OWNER'), "card_counts" AS (SELECT "disp".account_id, COUNT("card".card_id) AS "card_count" FROM "disp" INNER JOIN "card" ON "card".disp_id = "disp".disp_id WHERE "card".issued <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY "disp".account_id), "loan_info" AS (SELECT "loan".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", CASE WHEN BOOL_OR("loan".status = 'B') THEN 'defaulted' WHEN BOOL_OR("loan".status IN ('C', 'D')) THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END AS "loan_standing" FROM "loan" WHERE "loan".date <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY "loan".account_id), "activity" AS (SELECT "trans".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "money_out", MAX("trans".balance) AS "peak_balance" FROM "trans" WHERE "trans".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "trans".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "trans".account_id), "profiles" AS (SELECT "eligible_accounts".account_id, "eligible_accounts".opened_date, "owner_info".gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "owner_info".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "age", COALESCE("card_counts".card_count, 0) AS "card_count", COALESCE("loan_info".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", COALESCE("loan_info".loan_standing, 'no loan') AS "loan_standing", COALESCE("activity".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("activity".money_in, 0) AS "money_in", COALESCE("activity".money_out, 0) AS "money_out", COALESCE("activity".peak_balance, 0) AS "peak_balance" FROM "eligible_accounts" INNER JOIN "owner_info" ON "owner_info".account_id = "eligible_accounts".account_id LEFT JOIN "card_counts" ON "card_counts".account_id = "eligible_accounts".account_id LEFT JOIN "loan_info" ON "loan_info".account_id = "eligible_accounts".account_id LEFT JOIN "activity" ON "activity".account_id = "eligible_accounts".account_id) SELECT account_id, opened_date, gender, age, card_count, loan_count, loan_standing, transaction_count, money_in, money_out, peak_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS "peak_balance_rank" FROM "profiles" ORDER BY peak_balance_rank ASC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 <> '' AND ("q".q3 IS NULL OR "q".q3 = '') LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "q".q3, "d".forename, "d".surname, "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND "d".dob > DATE '1980-12-31' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> ''), "fastest" AS (SELECT q3 FROM "eligible" ORDER BY q3 ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "e".forename || ' ' || "e".surname AS "full_name", "e".race_name, "e".race_year, "e".q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "fastest" AS "f" ON "e".q3 = "f".q3 LIMIT 501

WITH "driver_race_fastest" AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS "fastest_lap_ms" FROM "laptimes" WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY raceid, driverid), "race_driver_rank" AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY fastest_lap_ms ASC) AS "lap_rank" FROM "driver_race_fastest") SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "count" FROM "race_driver_rank" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "r".lap_rank = 2 AND "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".position = 1 LIMIT 501

WITH "season_totals" AS (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "r".year, MAX("cs".points) AS "season_points" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid GROUP BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year), "career_totals" AS (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("st".season_points), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "season_totals" AS "st" ON "st".constructorid = "c".constructorid WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url), "ranked" AS (SELECT name, career_points, url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS "career_rank" FROM "career_totals") SELECT name, career_points, url FROM "ranked" WHERE career_rank <= 3 ORDER BY career_rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT q3 FROM "qualifying" WHERE q3 <> '' ORDER BY q3 ASC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "r".rank = 1 THEN "c".constructorid END) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".constructorid = "c".constructorid GROUP BY "c".nationality LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, COUNT("p".stop) AS "pit_stop_count" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) AS "qualifying_races" ON "qualifying_races".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 <> '' AND (split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) > 120 LIMIT 501

WITH "september_stops" AS (SELECT "p".milliseconds, "p".duration, "d".forename, "d".surname, "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01') SELECT forename || ' ' || surname AS "driver_name", duration AS "pit_stop_time", race_name, circuit_name, location AS "circuit_location" FROM "september_stops" WHERE milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM "september_stops") LIMIT 501

WITH "winning_drivers" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017), "chosen_driver" AS (SELECT driverid, forename, surname, nationality FROM "winning_drivers" ORDER BY dob ASC, forename ASC, surname ASC LIMIT 1), "first_win" AS (SELECT "ra".name, "ra".date FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "chosen_driver" AS "cd" ON "cd".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "r".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "ra".date ASC, "ra".name ASC LIMIT 1), "starts" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_starts" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "chosen_driver" AS "cd" ON "cd".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017) SELECT "cd".forename || ' ' || "cd".surname AS "full_name", "cd".nationality, "fw".name AS "first_race_won", "fw".date AS "first_race_date", "s".total_starts FROM "chosen_driver" AS "cd" CROSS JOIN "first_win" AS "fw" CROSS JOIN "starts" AS "s" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q2 ASC, "q".position ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 <> '' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "qx" INNER JOIN "races" AS "rx" ON "rx".raceid = "qx".raceid WHERE "rx".year = 2017 AND "qx".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "qx".q2 <> '') ORDER BY "d".surname ASC, "r".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 = '1:35.554' LIMIT 501

WITH "chinese_grands_prix" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".year, "r".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "c".name = 'Shanghai International Circuit' AND "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'), "selected_race" AS (SELECT raceid, year FROM "chinese_grands_prix" WHERE time = (SELECT MIN(time) FROM "chinese_grands_prix") ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT "sr".year, "runner_up".time AS "runner_up_time_gap" FROM "selected_race" AS "sr" INNER JOIN "results" AS "runner_up" ON "runner_up".raceid = "sr".raceid AND "runner_up".position = 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND (SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) < 98.000 LIMIT 501

WITH "circuit_times" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL), "extremes" AS (SELECT MIN(start_time) AS "earliest_time", MAX(start_time) AS "latest_time" FROM "circuit_times") SELECT (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY circuitref ASC) FROM "circuit_times", "extremes" WHERE start_time = earliest_time) AS "earliest_circuitrefs", (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY circuitref ASC) FROM "circuit_times", "extremes" WHERE start_time = latest_time) AS "latest_circuitrefs", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (latest_time - earliest_time))::BIGINT AS "gap_seconds" FROM "extremes" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1991-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST("r".fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 IS NULL ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid) AS "withdrawn_drivers" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "st" ON "st".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1962 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "st".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".position IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "r".raceid = "ra".raceid WHERE "ra".year = 1957 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_expense)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("ex".cost) AS "event_expense" FROM "expense" AS "ex" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "ex".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST("ex".expense_date AS DATE)) IN (9, 10) GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("b".spent) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 2019), 0) - COALESCE(SUM("b".spent) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 2020), 0) AS "difference" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT "kickoff".amount::NUMERIC / NULLIF("october".amount::NUMERIC, 0) AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "kickoff" INNER JOIN "event" AS "kickoff_event" ON "kickoff".link_to_event = "kickoff_event".event_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "october" ON "october".category = "kickoff".category INNER JOIN "event" AS "october_event" ON "october".link_to_event = "october_event".event_id WHERE "kickoff".category = 'Advertisement' AND "kickoff_event".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' AND "october_event".event_name = 'October Meeting' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING SUM("b".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b".amount), 0) = (SELECT MAX(event_ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM("b2".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b2".amount), 0) AS "event_ratio" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b2" ON "b2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e2".event_id) AS "ratios") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "x".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "soccer_attendees", ROUND((SELECT AVG(cnt)::NUMERIC FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "cnt" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "fall_counts"), 1) AS "fall_2019_average_attendees", CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > ROUND((SELECT AVG(cnt)::NUMERIC FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "cnt" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "fall_counts"), 1) THEN 'more' WHEN COUNT(*) < ROUND((SELECT AVG(cnt)::NUMERIC FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "cnt" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "fall_counts"), 1) THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' GROUP BY "e".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "attendance_count", COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "amount" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "major" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".link_to_major = "m".major_id AND "mem".position = 'Member' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member FROM "attendance") AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "mem".member_id LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "mem".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "m".college = 'College of Engineering' GROUP BY "m".department LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".remaining)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_remaining" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "e".cost > 50 GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_remaining DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("i".amount) AS "total_dues_dollars" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' AND "e".type = 'Game' AND "e".event_name ILIKE '%Football%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "no_enrolled_member_major_count" FROM "major" AS "target_major" WHERE "target_major"."college" = (SELECT "member_major"."college" FROM "member" AS "tyler" INNER JOIN "major" AS "member_major" ON "tyler"."link_to_major" = "member_major"."major_id" WHERE "tyler"."first_name" = 'Tyler' AND "tyler"."last_name" = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "enrolled" WHERE "enrolled"."link_to_major" = "target_major"."major_id") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "b".category ILIKE 'Advertisement' LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attended_members" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "j"."major_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "m"."member_id") AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a"."link_to_event" = "e"."event_id" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "a"."link_to_member" = "m"."member_id" INNER JOIN "major" AS "j" ON "m"."link_to_major" = "j"."major_id" WHERE "e"."event_name" = 'Football game' GROUP BY "j"."major_name" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "m"."member_id") = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m2"."member_id") AS "cnt" FROM "attendance" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e2" ON "a2"."link_to_event" = "e2"."event_id" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "a2"."link_to_member" = "m2"."member_id" INNER JOIN "major" AS "j2" ON "m2"."link_to_major" = "j2"."major_id" WHERE "e2"."event_name" = 'Football game' GROUP BY "j2"."major_name") AS "counts") ORDER BY "j"."major_name" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "m" WHERE "m".link_to_major = "major".major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_of_majors_with_no_members" FROM "major" LIMIT 501

SELECT member_group, ROUND(AVG(event_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_events_attended" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN "m".position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other student' END AS "member_group", "m".member_id, COUNT("a".link_to_event) AS "event_count" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) AS "member_attendance" GROUP BY member_group LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "x"."expense_description") AS "kind_count" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b"."budget_id" = "x"."link_to_budget" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e"."event_id" = "b"."link_to_event" WHERE "b"."amount" - "b"."spent" < 0 AND "e"."event_date" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "attendees" AS (SELECT "link_to_event", COUNT(*) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY "link_to_event"), "water_spend" AS (SELECT "b"."link_to_event", SUM("x"."cost") AS "water_total" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x"."link_to_budget" = "b"."budget_id" WHERE "x"."expense_description" ILIKE 'Water%' GROUP BY "b"."link_to_event") SELECT "e"."event_name", ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_total, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendee_count, 2) AS "amount_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendees" AS "a" ON "a"."link_to_event" = "e"."event_id" LEFT JOIN "water_spend" AS "w" ON "w"."link_to_event" = "e"."event_id" ORDER BY "e"."event_name" ASC, "e"."event_id" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "b".amount = (SELECT MAX("b2".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b2" WHERE "b2".link_to_event = "e".event_id) AND "b".amount = (SELECT MAX("b3".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b3" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x2" ON "x2".link_to_budget = "b3".budget_id WHERE "x2".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%') LIMIT 501

SELECT MAX("e".expense_date) AS "most_recent_expense_date", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President' AND "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX("e2".expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "e2".link_to_member = "m2".member_id WHERE "m2".position = 'Vice President') LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "counts" AS (SELECT "major".college, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id GROUP BY "major".college), "ranked" AS (SELECT college, number_of_majors, MAX(number_of_majors) OVER () AS "max_count" FROM "counts") SELECT college, number_of_majors FROM "ranked" WHERE number_of_majors = max_count ORDER BY college ASC LIMIT 501
