SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".hero_id = "target".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "shared_power" ON "shared_power".power_id = "target_power".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "h" ON "h".id = "shared_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "h".id <> "target".id AND "h".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AS "count_difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "l".id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "l".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE ("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-10' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p"."admission" IN ('+', '+(') THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest" AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::INTEGER END) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "laboratory"), "candidates" AS (SELECT "l"."T-BIL", "l".date, "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" CROSS JOIN "strongest" AS "s" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER = "s".highest_rnp AND "l"."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL), "max_bilirubin" AS (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS "highest_bilirubin" FROM "candidates") SELECT "c"."T-BIL", "c".date, "c".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "candidates" AS "c" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "c".id CROSS JOIN "max_bilirubin" AS "m" WHERE "c"."T-BIL" = "m".highest_bilirubin LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND "e".thrombosis <> 0 LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 10 WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND "l".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')), "patient_rnp" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) AS "rnp_titer" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible_patients" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id GROUP BY "l".id) SELECT id, rnp_titer FROM "patient_rnp" WHERE rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(rnp_titer) FROM "patient_rnp") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p"."id") AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "lp" ON "lp"."id" = "p"."id" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "lr" ON "lr"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."diagnosis" = 'MCTD' AND "lp"."plt" BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "lr"."rnp" IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("x".test_dates, 0)), 2) AS "average_lab_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "test_dates" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "x" ON "x".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, date, dna, MAX(dna) OVER (PARTITION BY id) AS "highest_dna" FROM "eligible") SELECT id, date, dna FROM "ranked" WHERE dna = highest_dna ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('16', '64', '256')) SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "qualifying_patients" AS "q" ON "q".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT "l"."id" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" GROUP BY "l"."id" HAVING BOOL_OR("l"."hct" IS NOT NULL AND ("l"."hct" <= 29 OR "l"."hct" >= 52)) AND BOOL_OR("l"."rnp" IN ('64', '256'))) AS "qualified" ON "qualified"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."admission" = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e"."Examination Date" IN (SELECT "Examination Date" FROM "examination" AS "e2" WHERE "e2".id = "e".id) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp = '256') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l"."date")::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INTEGER) AS "youngest_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 64 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT "e".symptoms AS "symptom" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'SLE' AND "e".thrombosis = 1 LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'SLE%' OR diagnosis ILIKE '%->SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e".first_exam_date - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS "first_exam_date" FROM "examination" GROUP BY id) AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "patient".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "laboratory".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" INNER JOIN "patient" ON "laboratory".id = "patient".id WHERE "laboratory".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "laboratory".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "laboratory".got < 60 AND "patient".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "patient".sex ORDER BY "patient".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id AS "patient ID", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "l"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l"."U-PRO"::NUMERIC >= 300) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE un < 30) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_out_of_range_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "u"."T-CHO", "u".admission, "u".id FROM (SELECT "l"."T-CHO", "p".admission, "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '+') UNION ALL SELECT "l"."T-CHO", "p".admission, "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-')) AS "u" LIMIT 501

WITH "recorded" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp, CASE WHEN "l".rnp = 'negative' THEN 0 ELSE "l".rnp::INTEGER END AS "rnp_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p"."First Date") = 1991 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX(rnp_level) AS "max_level" FROM "recorded") SELECT DISTINCT "r".id, "r".rnp AS "anti_rnp_level" FROM "recorded" AS "r" CROSS JOIN "highest" AS "h" WHERE "r".rnp_level = "h".max_level LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND hct IS NOT NULL AND ("U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "U-PRO"::INTEGER >= 300) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p"."admission" = '-' AND "l".ra IN ('-', '+-') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+')) LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_sample" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_scl70" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170 FROM "laboratory" ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT "l".id FROM "latest_sample" AS "l" INNER JOIN "latest_scl70" AS "s" ON "s".id = "l".id WHERE "l".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "s".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "s" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "u".id = "s".id WHERE "s".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "u"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "u"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "l"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l"."rnp"::INTEGER END) AS "highest_anti_rnp_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."cre" < 1.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hgb < 7.0 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, CASE WHEN "l".rnp = 'negative' THEN NULL ELSE "l".rnp::INTEGER END AS "rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".got >= 60) SELECT "p".id, "e".date, "e".rnp FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".rnp_value = (SELECT MAX(rnp_value) FROM "eligible") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND (("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450) OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "patient"."admission" = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient group", COUNT("laboratory"."ldh") AS "measurements within normal range" FROM "patient" INNER JOIN "laboratory" ON "laboratory"."id" = "patient"."id" WHERE "patient"."admission" IN ('+', '-') AND "laboratory"."ldh" < 500 GROUP BY CASE WHEN "patient"."admission" = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END ORDER BY CASE WHEN CASE WHEN "patient"."admission" = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END = 'admitted to the hospital' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patients_with_any_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN "l".id END) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) AS "highest_rnp_level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "p".id IN (SELECT "anemia_lab".id FROM "laboratory" AS "anemia_lab" WHERE "anemia_lab".hgb < 10) GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "all_lab".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "all_lab".rnp::INTEGER END) FROM "laboratory" AS "all_lab" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "outpatient" ON "outpatient".id = "all_lab".id WHERE "outpatient".admission = '-' AND "outpatient".id IN (SELECT "anemia_check".id FROM "laboratory" AS "anemia_check" WHERE "anemia_check".hgb < 10)) LIMIT 501

WITH "first_lab" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, got, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date ASC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "first_lab" WHERE got < 60 AND CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::INTEGER > 10 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, date, "U-PRO", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" <> '') AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rn = 1 LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 4 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 GROUP BY "l".id), "normal_only" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "highest_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id GROUP BY "l".id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".gpt >= 60) = 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".gpt IS NOT NULL) > 0) SELECT "p".birthday FROM "normal_only" AS "n" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "n".id ORDER BY "n".highest_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INTEGER - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "l".date), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "l".date)) < (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "p".birthday), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "p".birthday)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "age_completed_years", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna <> '' ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "has_elevated_rnp" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".id, care_setting) SELECT care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_rnp = 1) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_elevated_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_rnp = 0) AS "patients_with_no_elevated_result" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY care_setting ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_igg" AS (SELECT id, igg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "latest_igg" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rn = 1 WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

WITH "sle_patients" AS (SELECT id, diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%'), "patient_max" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, MAX("l".dna::DOUBLE PRECISION) AS "max_dna" FROM "sle_patients" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".dna IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id, "p".diagnosis), "top_max" AS (SELECT MAX(max_dna) AS "top_dna" FROM "patient_max") SELECT "pm".id, "pm".diagnosis, "l".dna AS "highest_anti_dna" FROM "patient_max" AS "pm" INNER JOIN "top_max" AS "tm" ON "pm".max_dna = "tm".top_dna INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "pm".id AND "l".dna::DOUBLE PRECISION = "pm".max_dna LIMIT 501

WITH "settings" AS (SELECT id, CASE WHEN admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" WHERE admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')), "latest_igg" AS (SELECT id, igg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL) SELECT "s".care_setting AS "care setting", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".igg > 900 AND "l".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "settings" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "latest_igg" AS "l" ON "l".id = "s".id AND "l".rn = 1 GROUP BY "s".care_setting ORDER BY "s".care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT id, rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory") SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "female_minus_male" FROM "latest" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rn = 1 AND "l".rnp IN ('32', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".rnp, "l".cpk FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "latest" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '+') AS "inpatient_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '-') AS "outpatient_count", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" IN ('+', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE ',' || REPLACE("diagnosis", ' ', '') || ',' LIKE '%,SLE,%' AND "diagnosis" NOT LIKE '%SLE susp%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ldh >= 500 GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" LIKE '%100%' OR "U-PRO" LIKE '%300%' OR "U-PRO" LIKE '%1000%' GROUP BY id) AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "e".symptoms <> '' ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC NULLS LAST, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "p".admission LIKE '%+%' ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis = 'SLE' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SjS susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE sm IN ('negative', '0')) AS "normal_sm" ON "normal_sm".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis = 0) AS "no_thrombosis" ON "no_thrombosis".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ("U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "U-PRO"::NUMERIC >= 30) OR "U-PRO" IN ('>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)')) AS "proteinuria" ON "proteinuria".id = "p".id WHERE "p".id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis <> 0) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "n" ON "n".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("r".rbc <= 3.5 OR "r".rbc >= 6.0) AND "n".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "n".rnp::INTEGER > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) / 12.0 + EXTRACT(DAY FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) / 365.2425), 1) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "female_patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp NOT IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', 'negative') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l".date, "p".birthday)) < 50 AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('0', '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_molecules" ON "single_bond_molecules".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecules_with_single_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'i') AS "distinct_iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 's') AS "distinct_sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_without_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_type", CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "molecule_id" FROM "bond" WHERE "bond_type" = '#') AS "triple_molecules" ON "triple_molecules"."molecule_id" = "a"."molecule_id" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "molecule_id" FROM "atom" WHERE "element" IN ('p', 'br')) AS "p_or_br_molecules" ON "p_or_br_molecules"."molecule_id" = "a"."molecule_id" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage_chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "hydrogen_atom_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_bond_counts" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, COUNT("b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT("b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label), "grouped" AS (SELECT CASE WHEN bond_count = single_bond_count THEN 'Every bond is single' ELSE 'Other molecules' END AS "saturation_group", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule_bond_counts" GROUP BY CASE WHEN bond_count = single_bond_count THEN 'Every bond is single' ELSE 'Other molecules' END) SELECT saturation_group, carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic FROM "grouped" ORDER BY saturation_group ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b"."bond_id" = "c"."bond_id" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m"."molecule_id" = "b"."molecule_id" WHERE "m"."label" = '+' AND "b"."bond_type" = '=' AND "a1"."element" = 'c' AND "a2"."element" = 'c' LIMIT 501

WITH "plus_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "bonded_atoms" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".atom_id, "p".element FROM "plus_atoms" AS "p" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "p".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "p".atom_id) SELECT "b".element, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "plus_atoms"), 2) AS "percentage_of_all_plus_molecule_atoms" FROM "bonded_atoms" AS "b" GROUP BY "b".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "bonded_atoms" GROUP BY element) AS "counts") ORDER BY "b".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 WHEN "a2".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id END) AS "count_atoms_bonded_to_chlorine" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' OR "a2".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "s" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id WHERE "s".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".molecule_id IN (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "a".molecule_id WHERE "other_a".atom_id IS NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "n_atom".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "n_atom" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "n_atom".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "n_atom".atom_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "n_atom".element = 'n' AND "n_atom".molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT "bad_nitrogen".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "bad_nitrogen" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "bad_c" ON "bad_c".atom_id = "bad_nitrogen".atom_id OR "bad_c".atom_id2 = "bad_nitrogen".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "bad_b" ON "bad_b".bond_id = "bad_c".bond_id WHERE "bad_nitrogen".element = 'n' AND "bad_b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".label, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id)) OVER (), 2) AS "percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "m".label ORDER BY "m".label DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element IN (SELECT "a2".element FROM "atom" AS "a2" GROUP BY "a2".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".molecule_id) = 1) GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT "molecule_id", COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "element" = 'c') AS "carbon_atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "element" = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atom_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY "molecule_id"), "bond_endpoint_counts" AS (SELECT "c"."bond_id", MAX(CASE WHEN "a1"."element" = 'c' OR "a2"."element" = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "touches_carbon" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id2" GROUP BY "c"."bond_id"), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b"."molecule_id", COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "bec".touches_carbon = 1) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b"."bond_type" IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "bond_endpoint_counts" AS "bec" ON "bec"."bond_id" = "b"."bond_id" GROUP BY "b"."molecule_id"), "ranked" AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) DESC, "ac".atom_count DESC, "m"."molecule_id" ASC) AS "rank", "m"."molecule_id", "m"."label" AS "carcinogenicity_label", "ac".atom_count, COALESCE("bc".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "ac".carbon_atom_count, "ac".chlorine_atom_count, COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bond_count, 0) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" WHERE "ac".carbon_atom_count > 0) SELECT rank, "molecule_id", carcinogenicity_label, atom_count, bond_count, carbon_atom_count, chlorine_atom_count, carbon_touching_bond_count, multiple_bond_count FROM "ranked" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "y" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON ("c".atom_id = "y".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "y".atom_id) INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".atom_id = CASE WHEN "c".atom_id = "y".atom_id THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END WHERE "y".element = 'y' AND "h".element = 'h' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) AS "average_bonds_per_atom" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_degrees" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element AS "element", COUNT(*) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY "a2".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond kind symbol", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "number of bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "number of element pairs", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity label" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "e".element, COALESCE("q".atom_count, 0) AS "atom_count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT element FROM "atom") AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "q".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "a".atom_id, "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') > 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) = 0) AS "q" GROUP BY "q".element) AS "q" ON "q".element = "e".element ORDER BY "e".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
